descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**ESCAPE TO THE ARCTIC**

Step onto three vast Arctic islands — frozen tundra, glacier mountains, and aurora-lit fjords. No enemies, no pressure, just the freedom to fly, sail, climb, and explore a stunning open-world Arctic wilderness unlike anything else in VR.

[media]

**WHAT'S NEW IN v1.0**

- MANUAL FLIGHT — Pilot the hang glider with full wind physics
- MANUAL SAILING — Sail your own boat between islands; mini-map in HUD
- 120fps QUEST 3 / 90fps QUEST 2 — Buttery smooth performance
- HDRP SKY — Aurora and northern lights rebuilt
- PARTICLE WATER — Cleaner, more reactive ocean surfaces
- NATURAL MOVEMENT — No jitter, no motion sickness

[media]
[media]
[media]

**WHAT YOU CAN DO**

- Hang glide off glacier cliffs
- Sail across the open Arctic ocean
- Ride a 1,000-foot mechanical ropeway
- Bungee jump from frozen cliffs
- Rescue arctic wildlife
- Launch fireworks over the aurora sky

[media]
[media]
[media]

**BUILT FOR EVERYONE**

- Comfort Mode default — no motion sickness
- Family-friendly — no violence, no fail states
- Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest Pro supported

We're Gioco Studio — 3 people in Singapore. We wanted a game you could hand to anyone and they'd just get it.

🎯 **50% off through Summer Fest**

🏔️ Follow @giocostudio for free DLC drops
